import networkx as nx

evidence_graph = nx.MultiDiGraph()

# Jamaica node
evidence_graph.add_node(
    "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaica",
    name="Jamaica",
    example_id="WebQTest-0"
)
# Language target nodes
evidence_graph.add_node(
    "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaican English",
    name="Jamaican English",
    example_id="WebQTest-0"
)
evidence_graph.add_node(
    "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaican Creole English Language",
    name="Jamaican Creole English Language",
    example_id="WebQTest-0"
)

# Language relationships (edges)
edges = [
    ("WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaica",
     "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaican English",
     {"predicate": "location.country.official_language",
      "example_id": "WebQTest-0"}),
    ("WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaica",
     "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaican Creole English Language",
     {"predicate": "location.country.languages_spoken",
      "example_id": "WebQTest-0"}),
    ("WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaica",
     "WebQTest-0::entity::Jamaican English",
     {"predicate": "location.country.languages_spoken",
      "example_id": "WebQTest-0"}),
]

for src, tgt, attrs in edges:
    evidence_graph.add_edge(src, tgt, **attrs)

print(f"Evidence graph: {evidence_graph.number_of_nodes()} nodes, {evidence_graph.number_of_edges()} edges")
for u, v, data in evidence_graph.edges(data=True):
    print(f"  {evidence_graph.nodes[u]['name']} -[{data['predicate']}]-> {evidence_graph.nodes[v]['name']}")

GRAPH_FINAL(evidence_graph)
